author: Inside Edition
description: A gunman opened fire Monday at the archaeological site of Teotihuacan, near Mexico City, killing a Canadian woman and wounding at least three others before taking his own life, authorities said. Mexico’s Security Cabinet said it deployed a coordinated operation involving police and National Guard forces after reports of gunshots at the site. A firearm, a bladed weapon and cartridges were recovered at the scene. The motive for the attack remains unknown. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum wrote on social media that the shooting would be investigated and that she was in touch with the Canadian Embassy.
title: Tourist Killed, Many Injured in Mass Shooting at Mexico Pyramids

author: Inside Edition
description: Bill and Allison Cosens say they got a phone call saying their missing 11-year-old beagle-mix named Archer had been found. They say they were sent a photo of the dog being prepped for surgery with a wound. The couple says the caller identified himself as a vet and said Archer had been run down by a car. The owners were told the surgery would cost $2,746. They were willing to pay, but then they realized that some things did not add up. Four days later, Archer suddenly showed up at their front door.
title: Scammer Uses AI To Try To Swindle Family After Their Dog Disappears

author: Inside Edition
description: Bob McCaffrey is accused of the brutal murder of Lisa McBride in 1990. He was 18 years old at the time, reportedly fixated on McBride, his neighbor. When McBride did not show up for work one day, her family went to her home. The 27-year-old's body was later found. McBride's murder went unsolved for decades until advances in DNA testing led authorities to McCaffrey. McCaffrey has pled not guilty to murder charges. He had been arrested previously in connection with his wife Gayle McCaffrey's disappearance. A grand jury did not indict him for his murder but he was convicted of obstruction of justice for lying to detectives in connection with the investigation.
title: Man Whose Wife Disappeared Accused Of Murdering Lisa McBride In 1990

author: Inside Edition
description: This suspect tried to strike a balance between intimidating and respectful. Not only did he greet the hotel clerk when he walked in, he also thanked her on the way out. The Sheriff in Franklin County Ohio released this video of a robbery at a Red Roof Inn. They say the suspect entered the lobby and when the clerk appeared he demanded she fill a bag with money, all while he implied that he had a weapon. The clerk complied, filling the bag. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Thanks Hotel Clerk After Demanding She Fill A Bag With Money

author: Inside Edition
description: Cops in California say a suspect's plan to steal valuable Lego pieces wasn't built on a solid foundation. Irvine Police say they found out about the scam when Target shoppers purchased Lego sets only to find important pieces were missing. Cops say after the suspect purchased Lego sets, he took them home, removed expensive pieces, put bags of pasta in the boxes and resealed them. They say the pasta was meant to mimic the sounds of missing Legos. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Replaced Pricey LEGO Pieces From Boxes With Dried Pasta: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: Several Chinese-made humanoid robots showed off their speed and athleticism at a recent half-marathon in Beijing. This is the second year the robots have been included in these races. The robots in last year's race were slower and riddled with mishaps. This year, some of the machines beat humans by over 10 minutes, highlighting how quickly the industry is evolving and advancing. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Humanoid Robots Outperform Humans During Beijing Half-Marathon
